commonStructure: A cell-specific health coordinate must order two cells that experienced the same imposed stress. Later landmarks can increase signal because degradation mechanisms have separated, but they also shorten forecast horizon; sparse capacity checks then collapse many cells onto tied EOL rounds and remove the comparable pairs needed to validate that ordering.

variableMapping.digitalTwin: observed state at synchronization time L -> latent individual degradation state
variableMapping.acceleratedLife: condition-level stress law plus within-condition random effect -> interval-resolved failure order

evidence.earlyLandmark: At R1, capacity level and log slope produced blocked concordance 0.571 and 0.592.
evidence.laterLandmarks: R2 recent log slope reached 0.702 and R3 capacity level reached 0.723, with a common coefficient sign in every leave-batch-out fit.
evidence.resolutionLimit: Only 47 non-tied within-held-batch pairs remained for R2 and R3, below the registered 60-pair gate. The apparent improvement therefore remains candidate-generation evidence.
evidence.independentSourceBoundary: The Aurora paper describes 36 long-term LFP/graphite cells, while the official archive exposes 32 metadata records explicitly identifying LiFePO4. Zero cycling entries or cell-level outcomes were opened.

conditionsForTransfer: The landmark feature must be defined from the same kind of standardized full-capacity observations using actual cycle positions.
A complete start or production batch must be held out so condition and individual ordering are not mixed.
Endpoint timing must leave at least the registered number of non-tied comparable pairs.
The independent archive must map every declared cohort member to one metadata and one cycling record before outcomes are inspected.
Chemistry transfer may support only an ordinal frailty claim unless absolute lifetime calibration is separately validated.
breakConditions: Selecting R2 or R3 after seeing the same RWTH outcomes cannot confirm the coordinate.
Treating 47 pairs as if they passed a precommitted 60-pair gate converts low endpoint resolution into an outcome-dependent threshold change.
Assuming that the four Aurora records missing from explicit LFP metadata are equivalent to the paper cohort breaks cell lineage.
Using per-cycle partial capacity or a smoothed crossing as an exact full-capacity EOL without independent validation changes the endpoint.
minimumValidation: First reconcile a signed or official 36-cell Aurora cohort manifest. Separately identify a source or collect a same-condition cohort whose capacity checks yield at least 60 blocked non-tied pairs. Freeze one RWTH-developed coordinate before any target cycling row is opened; require at least 90% coverage, 24 observed events, 100 target comparable pairs, concordance at least 0.65, bootstrap lower 95% bound above 0.50, and an independent implementation.
simultaneousImpact: A valid transportable coordinate would narrow cell-level RUL, bounded battery digital twins, and random-effects accelerated-life models at once. The current negative stop instead establishes that later signal strength and independent cohort lineage are separate gates; neither can substitute for the other.
validationStatus: structural connection strengthened; transport hypothesis remains untested because no candidate-source pair passed all opening gates
